text: Existing OpenAI SDK code works unchanged by just pointing the base URL to DeepInfra's endpoint
quote: Point your existing OpenAI SDK to `https://api.deepinfra.com/v1/openai` and your code works without changes. No migration required.

text: Provides an OpenAI-compatible chat completions API, requiring only base URL and model name changes
quote: OpenAI-compatible chat completions API — just change the base URL and model name.

text: Supports multi-turn conversations by including full message history in each request
quote: To create a longer conversation, include the full message history in every request. The model uses this context to provide better answers.

text: Priority service tier gives faster time-to-first-token and higher throughput during peak demand
quote: Priority requests get faster time-to-first-token and higher throughput during peak demand.

text: Flex service tier offers lower-cost, lower-priority inference (with a 20% discount) suited for non-production or async workloads
quote: Set service_tier to "flex" to run Chat Completions requests at a lower cost in exchange for slower response times and occasional resource unavailability.

text: An optional fail_fast parameter returns an immediate 429 instead of queuing the request
quote: Set the optional `fail_fast` parameter to `true` to get an immediate HTTP 429 instead of waiting.

text: A reasoning_effort parameter lets you control reasoning depth for reasoning models
quote: Controls reasoning depth for reasoning models. See [Reasoning Models](/chat/reasoning).

text: Deploy your own fine-tuned LLM on dedicated GPU instances (A100/H100/H200/B200/B300) with autoscaling and a private endpoint
quote: Need to run your own fine-tuned weights, or require data isolation? Deploy a dedicated instance on A100/H100/H200/B200/B300 with autoscaling and a private endpoint

text: Rent GPU clusters (B200/B300) with SSH access for training and full custom control
quote: GPU Clusters for training and full control. Rent a B200 or B300 cluster with SSH access and run whatever you want.

text: Operates as a broad AI inference cloud covering LLMs, vision, embeddings, image, video, and speech models at scale
quote: DeepInfra is an AI inference cloud that makes it simple to run the latest machine learning models at scale — LLMs, vision, embeddings, image generation, video generation, speech, and more.

text: Billing is strictly per-token with no idle GPU charges, minimums, seat fees, or long-term contracts
quote: You only pay per token — no idle GPU time, no minimums, no seat fees.

text: Offers image and video generation models such as FLUX, Stable Diffusion, and text-to-video
quote: FLUX, Stable Diffusion, text-to-video, and more.

text: Provides state-of-the-art embedding and reranker models for search and RAG pipelines
quote:
Embeddings & Reranking

State-of-the-art embedding and reranker models for search and RAG.

text: Offers speech recognition (Whisper) and text-to-speech models
Supports vision and OCR models for visual understanding and document text extraction
quote:
Vision & OCR

Multimodal models for visual understanding and document text extraction.

text: Zero data retention policy with SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certification keeps inputs/outputs private
quote: With our zero retention policy your inputs, your outputs, and your user data stay private. DeepInfra is SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certified.
